messages.subject: Time recording reminder - March narratives outstanding
messages.plaintextBody:
Hello,

Our records show unposted time for March. Please ensure all narratives are submitted by close of business on 3 April so we can run the month-end WIP report. Matters with a high WIP balance should be reviewed for interim billing.

Thank you
Accounts
Whitfield Carter LLP
